audit_items.proof_trace: Both `debts_value_usd_non_liquidation` (L1197-1198) and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` (L1283-1284) consistently call `get_price_with_check` for every asset in their respective loops, enforcing the EMA-spot deviation assertion before returning the EMA price. These are the sole price-valuation functions called by `is_obligation_safe`, which is asserted in both `handle_borrow` (L434) and `handle_withdraw` (L342) — the only state-modifying borrow/collateral paths. The liquidation path uses `get_price` (no check) intentionally to prevent griefing of liquidators, which is a known security design choice and not a bypass of this property.
